concurrency.title: Concurrency (Parallel Workers)
concurrency.description: Number of parallel isolated browser instances running concurrently (default 5).

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Number of pending profiles to fetch and process from Supabase per run.

delayBetweenRequests.title: Delay Between Requests (ms)
delayBetweenRequests.description: Delay between each profile navigation per worker (default 1600ms).

cookies.title: Multi-Account Session Cookies Pool
cookies.description: Pool of session cookies for multiple X accounts (raw cookie strings or objects with alias + cookie_string). Rotates every 46-49 profiles or when rate-limited.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Number of retry passes for profiles that hit transient errors or rate limits.

supabaseUrl.title: Supabase Project URL
supabaseUrl.description: Supabase project URL (defaults to SUPABASE_URL env var).

supabaseAnonKey.title: Supabase Anon Key
supabaseAnonKey.description: Supabase API key (defaults to SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env var).
